newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana Stock Exchange closes lower in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana Stock Exchange closes lower in thin trade.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange closed lower in thin trade on Wednesday as shares in market leader Ashanti Goldfields , lost 500 cedis against a background of falling world gold prices, trading results showed.
The GSE All-Share Index fell by 1.36 points to 382.15 and market capitalisation slipped to 3,161.88 billion cedis from 3,209.76 billion cedis.
Ashanti closed at 28,500 while the other main loser, Mobil Oil Ghana Ltd, closed down 100 cedis at 6,500 cedis.
Offers exceeded bids by 1,221,380 shares to 342,500 and volume was light, with 48,670 shares traded.
No gains were recorded following rises on Monday.
